notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the friend/ignore/who family: SMSG_FRIEND_LIST (status-conditional tail), SMSG_IGNORE_LIST, SMSG_FRIEND_STATUS (result-code-keyed tail + the ERR_FRIEND_*/ERR_IGNORE_* vocabulary), SMSG_WHO, and the CMSG bodies incl. the full WhoRequest (level range, name/guild, race/class masks, zones, terms, server caps 10/4). MSUI implements the list/who parses byte-correctly and all add/del/refresh sends, but degrades SMSG_FRIEND_STATUS to a blind list re-request and only builds the default name-only /who query.
